text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I've finally managed to clear away all the mountains of paperwork I've been wrestling with day after day...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the meeting with Mejiro Bright
continued just like that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer-sama,
you appear to be a little tired~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You've been working non-stop lately,
and I am worried about you.
choice_data_list: I've already wrapped up my work, so I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~ That is wonderful news~!
Congratulations♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I would simply love to
show my appreciation to you, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“...... That's it~!
How about a picnic in the academy gardens
on our next day off?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The weather has been quite lovely lately,
so I am certain you will be able to relax and enjoy yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, then it's decided♪
I shall take care of all the preparations
for the day~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you do not need to prepare anything.
Just bring yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of our promise, arriving at the spot
Mejiro Bright specified, I found Bright
spreading out a plastic picnic sheet—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ei, hup.
Phew, that should do it~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ Trainer.
It is already time for our appointment, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "I have just finished laying out the picnic sheet. Please wait just a moment longer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? What was it
I was planning to do next, I wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "...Oh, that's right! I was supposed to set out the tea set~♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
First, let me take the saucers
out of the basket, and...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Shuffle, shuffle, shuffle~)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then, a strong gust of wind blew—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flap flap flap~)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ The picnic mat we took the trouble
to lay out has been blown away by the wind~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I shall go and search
for a picnic sheet~.
choice_data_list: Want me to lend a hand...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the thought, but
today is meant for you to take a breather, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Please don't lift a finger,
and just relax and wait right here♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hearing Mejiro Bright say that, I decided to just wait for her to get ready without doing anything.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, Mejiro Bright continued to prepare for the picnic as best she could in her own way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's slice up the fruit
that we received from the cafeteria staff♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh dear, where did I put
the paring knife, I wonder~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Munch, munch~)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Here is some black tea.
Dober was kind enough to share some with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Umm~ first, we put the tea leaves into this pot, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Slowly, slowly, slowly~)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bright takes everything at her own leisurely pace.
Yet, watching over her somehow brought
a sense of peace to my heart—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that is true~.
Decorating with flowers would make it feel so glamorous.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I shall go prepare it, so please wait just a moment~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, my mind felt at ease,
and the fatigue built up from daily life drained away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it took a little longer than planned,
but how was it today~?
choice_data_list: I was really able to relax!
I feel like I can give it my all again starting tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~ I am so very glad
I could be of service, truly♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "It's usually when you're at your busiest that your heart feels all cramped up, but—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"At times like this, let's take it slow and easy,
without panicking or rushing~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a day off where I felt like Mejiro Bright taught me something truly important.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, I am so very glad to see you feeling refreshed~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the goal we are aiming for
is still much further ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Without letting our focus waver,
let us take our time at our own steady pace~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a day off where I felt like Mejiro Bright taught me something truly important.
